hypotheses.H1: On both arms, paired success of full+look_again minus full has a 95% bootstrap interval above zero (replication of the gap_budget_v2 held-out result with 500 fresh seeds).
hypotheses.H2: The correction chosen on dev seeds (look_again, perception) is the largest gain of the four corrections on each arm. This is reported either way; it is not a pass/fail bar.
hypotheses.H3: The sign of the interaction term (sum of single budgets minus oracle_all) differs between the arms, as in gap_budget_v2. Reported with a bootstrap 95% interval on each arm; if both intervals include zero the earlier sign flip is not supported.
hypotheses.H4: Retargeting budget at the assumed 0.5 degree joint error is indistinguishable from zero on both arms.

rule: No threshold or error constant is changed after seeing results; all four corrections are reported.
